name: Smuggler's Special
summary: Friz sends you to Captain Bentcoin on Eastwind Shore with a crate called The Friz Special. The delivery is her answer to his attempt to muscle in on her turf.

sections.title: Friz's Answer
sections.body: Captain Bentcoin threatens you when you step onto his ship. Friz has sent you with a crate called The Friz Special, meant for the captain on Eastwind Shore. Her goods were supposed to come straight to her, and she believes Bentcoin is trying to muscle in on her turf. She calls this her second lesson and presents the crate as a fitting answer to his bargaining.

sections.title: The Crate
sections.body: When Bentcoin receives the crate from Friz, he takes it as a sign that she knows she has been beaten. Then he hears a ticking sound.

faq.answer: Friz sent you to Captain Bentcoin with a crate called The Friz Special after goods meant for her were diverted.
Captain Bentcoin is the captain Friz sends you to meet on his ship along Eastwind Shore.
You are carrying The Friz Special, a crate Friz made for Captain Bentcoin.

faq.q: Why is Friz sending a gift?
faq.answer: Friz says goods you procured from the Eastsea pirates were meant to be shipped directly to her, and she believes Bentcoin is trying to muscle in on her turf.

faq.q: Where do I find Captain Bentcoin?
faq.answer: Captain Bentcoin is on his ship along Eastwind Shore.

faq.q: What does Bentcoin say when I arrive?
faq.answer: Bentcoin threatens to keelhaul you for stepping aboard his ship and demands a reason to spare you.
